# Story 23.2: Extract one shared input sanitizer and fix the valueChanges subscription leak with takeUntilDestroyed

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want `onQuantityInput`/`onPriceInput` unified into one shared sanitizer and the `valueChanges` subscription fixed with `takeUntilDestroyed`,
So that sanitization logic is deduplicated and the real subscription leak is closed (P2 item #2 from Aspect 2 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Story 23.1's red-phase tests pass: `onQuantityInput` and `onPriceInput` route through one shared sanitizer with identical accept/reject behavior, and the `valueChanges` subscription is torn down on destroy.
2. A single shared sanitizer function is extracted and used by both `onQuantityInput` (line ~191) and `onPriceInput` (line ~205) in `add-position-dialog.component.ts` — no duplicated sanitization logic remains inline.
3. Both inputs share one sanitizer with unchanged accept/reject behavior: the same input strings that were accepted before are still accepted, and the same ones rejected are still rejected.
4. No `valueChanges` subscription survives component destroy — the subscription at line ~120 is piped through `takeUntilDestroyed` (or equivalent) so it completes when the component is destroyed.
5. The previously-skipped tests from Story 23.1 are unskipped (`.skip()` removed) and pass under `nx test dms-material`; the full dms-material suite is green with no pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1–#4): Remove skip markers and confirm red.
  - [ ] 1.1 In the specs added by Story 23.1, remove every `it.skip` marker and run `nx test dms-material`, confirming the new assertions FAIL against current code (red).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2, #3): Extract one shared input sanitizer.
  - [ ] 2.1 In `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/add-position-dialog/add-position-dialog.component.ts`, extract a single shared sanitizer function that encapsulates the accept/reject logic currently duplicated in `onQuantityInput` (line ~191) and `onPriceInput` (line ~205).
  - [ ] 2.2 Replace both inline sanitization blocks with calls to the shared sanitizer, preserving identical accept/reject behavior for all input strings.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #4): Fix the valueChanges subscription leak with takeUntilDestroyed.
  - [ ] 3.1 In `add-position-dialog.component.ts`, pipe the `valueChanges` subscription at line ~120 through `takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)` (or equivalent) so it completes when the component is destroyed.
  - [ ] 3.2 Verify no lingering subscription survives after destroy — the subscription count returns to zero or the observable stops emitting post-destroy.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #5): Confirm green suite.
  - [ ] 4.1 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm fully green with Story 23.1's tests now passing (unskipped).

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `add-position-dialog.component.ts` currently sanitizes `onQuantityInput` (line ~191) and `onPriceInput` (line ~205) separately, duplicating logic. Separately, the `valueChanges` subscription at line ~120 is not torn down on destroy — a real memory leak. Extracting one shared sanitizer + fixing with `takeUntilDestroyed` removes duplication and closes the leak (P2 item #2 from Aspect 2).
- **First task is always unskip → confirm red → implement.** The red-phase tests from Story 23.1 define the target; do not edit their assertions to make them pass, only the production code.
- **Behavioral preservation:** the shared sanitizer must produce identical accept/reject results as the two inline blocks did before extraction. Do not "improve" or tighten validation beyond what already exists — that would be a behavior change outside this story's scope.
- **takeUntilDestroyed:** import `DestroyRef` from `@angular/core` and inject it in the component constructor (or use the `takeUntilDestroyed()` operator with an injected `DestroyRef`). This is the Angular 16+ idiomatic way to auto-complete subscriptions on destroy without manual `unsubscribe()`.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; dms-material tests run via `nx test dms-material`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/account-panel/open-positions/add-position-dialog/add-position-dialog.component.ts` (extract shared sanitizer, pipe `valueChanges` through `takeUntilDestroyed`).
- Modify: Story 23.1's spec (remove `.skip()` markers only — no assertion changes).
